#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: Today is the day, right? We are going to ice skate with Shanice!
You: You seem more excited than I would think, what changed?
Bot: Your reassuring made me realise that my fears are unfounded. I’m a sexbot after all, so ice skating should be easy for me!
You: I feel like you didn’t learn anything from that fall.
Bot: But I did! Now I know that l need to check the state of skates and ice before starting skating.
You: …
I thought it would be alright, but now I’m starting to worry…
You: Just go slow, at least at the beginning…
